title: GTA 6 File Size: Massive 210GB Download on PS5
description: Recent reports from Eurogamer reveal that Grand Theft Auto 6 will require a massive 210GB download on the PlayStation 5 console.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Revealed to Have a Massive 210GB Download Size on PlayStation 5

There was really any chance that Grand Theft Auto 6 wasn't going to be a big download, given the immense scale and ambition associated with Rockstar Games' upcoming title. However, thanks to some new information brought to light by Eurogamer, we now have a hard number regarding just how much space players will need to clear on their hardware.

### A New Milestone for Storage Requirements

According to the latest reports, players on the PlayStation 5 will be looking at a massive **210GB** download when the game arrives. Modern triple-A game development has continually pushed the boundaries of storage technology, and open-world titles of this magnitude demand vast amounts of data for high-resolution textures, complex assets, and sprawling environments. While a download size of this scale is certainly heavy, it aligns with expectations surrounding the sheer scope of the next entry in the franchise.

### Preparing Your Console for the Launch

With a confirmed download footprint of 210GB, console storage management is going to become a priority for PlayStation 5 owners. Given the base capacity of the console's internal SSD, having a game of this size will require significant preparation. Many players will likely need to evaluate external or expanded M.2 SSD storage options to ensure they have enough breathing room not just for GTA 6, but for the rest of their gaming library as well.

### Editor's Take

A 210GB download on the PlayStation 5 underscores the unprecedented technical scope of GTA 6. While managing console storage space and download times will pose a minor logistical challenge, it is a small price to pay for what promises to be a landmark release in modern gaming history. Players should definitely consider preparing their systems ahead of time.
